description: This file contains the PHP source code defining the Subscription model class in the Opencart system, specifically within the Opencart.Catalog.Model.Account namespace. It includes methods for managing subscription data such as retrieving, updating, and counting subscriptions, as well as accessing subscription histories and histories counts.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Model class handling database interactions related to customer subscriptions, including retrieving, updating, and counting subscriptions and their histories.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves subscription details for a specific subscription ID belonging to the current customer, returning an array of subscription data including options, payment, and shipping methods.

methods.name: getSubscriptionByOrderProductId
methods.description: Fetches subscription data associated with a specific order ID and product ID for the current customer.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Returns a list of subscriptions for the current customer with optional start and limit parameters for pagination.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptions
methods.description: Returns the total count of active subscriptions for the current customer.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionByShippingAddressId
methods.description: Returns the total number of subscriptions associated with a specific shipping address ID for the current customer.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionByPaymentAddressId
methods.description: Returns the total number of subscriptions associated with a specific payment address ID for the current customer.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of history entries for a specific subscription, including date added, status, comment, and notification flag.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Returns the total number of history entries associated with a specific subscription.

methods.name: editRemaining
methods.description: Updates the remaining count for a specific subscription.

methods.name: editTrialRemaining
methods.description: Updates the trial remaining count for a specific subscription.
